entities.name: Gregory Obinna Ochiagha
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gregory Obinna Ochiagha was a Nigerian Roman Catholic bishop. He was the first Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Orlu, a position he held until he retired in 2008 and handed over to Bishop Augustine T. Ukwuoma his successor.
